desc: Identify that N is small while M is the only large dimension, so a small finite automaton over LCS DP rows is required.
Confirm the row is nondecreasing with increments 0/1, giving at most 2^N states, and that letters absent from S can be grouped with multiplicity 26 minus distinct letters in S.
Implement the full LCS-DP-row automaton solution (parse, state encoding, per-letter transitions with grouping of non-S letters, length-M DP modulo 998244353, aggregate by popcount, print).
Validate correctness against samples 1-3 (all passed) via the worker's SAMPLE TESTS verdict.
Ensure performance is adequate for N=10 (1024 states) and M=100 — memoized transitions keep it well within limits.
